description: This Java class is a serializer for the 'LoanChargeDeletedBusinessEvent' in the Fineract project. It converts business events related to deleted loan charges into an Avro DTO format for external event handling.

classes.name: LoanChargeDeletedBusinessEventSerializer
classes.description: A serializer for converting LoanChargeDeletedBusinessEvent instances into Avro DTO format for message serialization and transmission.

methods.name: canSerialize
methods.description: Determines if the serializer can handle the provided business event, specifically if it is a LoanDeleteChargeBusinessEvent.

methods.name: toAvroDTO
methods.description: Converts a LoanDeleteChargeBusinessEvent into its corresponding Avro DTO (LoanChargeDeletedV1).

methods.name: getSupportedSchema
methods.description: Returns the class type of the Avro schema supported by this serializer, LoanChargeDeletedV1.
